newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it kills 20 Kurdish rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it kills 20 Kurdish rebels.

text.p: Security forces have killed 20 Kurdish guerrillas in separate clashes this week in southeastern Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels had been killed in fighting in the provinces of Siirt, Sirnak, Hakkari, Diyarbakir and Van.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in a 12-year-old conflict between troops and the rebels, fighting for autonomy or independence from Ankara.
Anatolian news agency said the guerrillas killed a pro-state militiaman near the Iranian border on Thursday.
